wn.name: WaterCraft
wn.numbers: Konke lapha kuyisisekeli sokubala. Unjiniyela wamanzi uhlola yonke imiphumela; izinombolo azisiyo isitifiketi noma idizayini esemthethweni.
wn.privacy: Inethiwekhi yakho ihlala kule projekthi nakule khompyutha. Akukho okuthunyelwa noma kuphi.
wn.stopped: Imisiwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi: uhlu luyilokho okwenziwe kuphela.
wn.err.nonet: Asikho inethiwekhi yamanzi kule projekthi okwamanje. Qala ngokudweba ama-junction, isitoreji namapayipi ngamathuluzi e-Water mains.
wn.err.noloads: Namathisela okungenani umugqa womthwalo owodwa kuqala.
wn.err.trace_node: Khetha isitoreji noma ithange lapho ukulandelela kuqala khona.
wn.err.not_configured: WaterCraft ayikwazanga ukufinyelela isixazululi samanzi. Layisha kabusha ikhasi.
wn.dem.help: Umuntu oyedwa ngomugqa ngamunye: id, x, y, uhlobo, inani. Uhlobo kungaba: {kinds}, noma flow ukuze uthayiphe ukugeleza. Inani liyiyunithi (izindlu), indawo (amaekhari, noma amahektha kumethrikhi) noma ukugeleza. Ngalunye luya kwe-junction eseduze kakhulu.
wn.dem.share: Yabelana ngomthwalo phakathi kwama-junction aseduze, cishe ngo-300 ft (90 m)
wn.dem.starting: Ukusetshenziswa ngendlu noma ngeyekhari kuyisilinganiso sokuqala, hhayi umgomo. Yishintshe ngezibalo zokuklama zenkampani yakho yamanzi ngaphambi kokuthembela emphumeni.
wn.dem.applied: Izidingo zibhalwe kuma-Water mains. Hlehlisa kuzibuyisela emuva.
wn.fire.help: Ngalowo nomvimba womlilo (noma ngama-junction onke uma kungekho olumakiwe): ukugeleza akwazi ukukunikeza uma uxinzelelo lugcina okusele, kutholwe ngesixazululi esifanayo naleso sewindi le-Water mains.
wn.fire.mult: Isilinganiso sesidingo (1 = isidingo njengoba sidwetshiwe; sebenzisa isilinganiso sakho sosuku lokuphakama)
wn.limit.base: uxinzelelo olusezingeni eliphansi ngaphambi kokuthathwa kwanoma yini
wn.crit.help: Ikhipha ipayipi ngalinye ngokulandelanayo iphinde ibale futhi: ukuthi isidingo esingakanani sivinjwa, nokuthi ama-junction awela kuphi ngaphansi koxinzelelo oluncane. Uma kukhona ama-valve abekwe kumapayipi, ungasusa lonke ingxenye enama-valve.
wn.q.help: Ilandela amanzi kuwo wonke umzila wamahora angu-24: ukuthi adala kangakanani, ukuthi kusele ikhlorini elingakanani, noma avela kuphi. Isebenzisa iphethini yesidingo nezinga lamathange e-Water mains.
wn.q.limits: Ukubola kwe-first-order kuphela, ithange liyivolumu eyodwa exubile, akukho masiteshi okukhulisa uxinzelelo okwamanje. Qhuba isikhathi esanele ukuze iphethini iphindeke ngaphambi kokufunda usuku lokugcina.
wn.pc.help: Ifunda izindawo ezidwetshwe kule phrojekthi. Isiza ngasinye siba ikhasimende esikhungweni saso; ukusetshenziswa kwaso kunquma isidingo. Tshela ukuthi yiphi isiza ibe ukusetshenziswa kwani, eyodwa ngomugqa njenge-id = ukusetshenziswa (ama-id namagama atholakala ohlwini lwezindawo), noma khetha ukusetshenziswa kumbe kumbe kwezinye.
wn.pc.perunit: Indawo yendlu eyodwa (amayunithi endawo yephrojekthi; 0 = indlu eyodwa ngesiza)
wn.pc.none: Le phrojekthi ayinazo izindawo okwamanje. Zidwetshe noma zilethe kuqala ku-CivilCraft.
wn.sc.help: Isimo ngasinye yigama nokushintsha kwenethiwekhi. Imigqa: close P12, open P12, demand x1.5, demand J5 120, diameter P3 16, c P4 80, pump P1 off, tank T1 level 130, reservoir R1 head 820, fire J9 1000. Isimo sokuqala yisisekelo esinye esiqhathaniswa nasso.
wn.sc.lowest: Ukuhlangana okungu-12 okunengcindezi ephansi kakhulu kunoma yisiphi isimo:
wn.pd.help: Ukugijima okujwayelekile kulethe yonke imidingo noma yingcindezi. Lapha ukuhlangana kulethe kuphela okuvunyelwe yingcindezi yakho: lutho ngaphansi noma ku-ingcindezi ephansi kakhulu, konke ngaphezu noma ku-ingcindezi egcwele. Engeza izixhumanisi ezivuzayo (node, coefficient) kanye nokuvuza emapayipini uma uzazi.
wn.pd.leakc: Ukuvuza emapayipini: ukugeleza ngamayunithi angu-1000 obude ku-1 yengcindezi (0 = akukho)
wn.en.help: Imithetho yokulawula, eyodwa ngomugqa, ngamagama ajwayelekile: LINK P1 CLOSED IF NODE T1 ABOVE 140, LINK P1 OPEN IF NODE T1 BELOW 110, LINK P1 OPEN AT TIME 6, LINK P1 CLOSED AT CLOCKTIME 22. Ama-valvu, eyodwa ngomugqa: id, ipayipi, FCV noma PSV, isetha (ukugeleza, noma ingcindezi). Ukugijima kubika amazinga amathangi, izenzakalo zemithetho nokuthi iphampu ngayinye ibiza malini kangakanani ukuyisebenzisa.
wn.en.valves: Ama-valvu (id, ipayipi, FCV noma PSV, isetha ku-{q} noma {p})
wn.en.tariff: Intengo ngehora losuku (izinombolo ezingu-24; engenalutho = eyodwa)
wn.en.problems: Izenzakalo zamathangi angu-{n} (agcwele noma ayize): ithangi libanjwe ekukhawulweni kwalo.
wn.em.help: Kwenzekani, nokuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani, uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ukuphuka kwephayipi elikhulu kususa ipayipi ekusebenzeni (ama-valvu azungeze kulo uma edwetshiwe); umlilo udonsa amanzi ku-hydrant; ukucima kukagesi kumisa amaphampu (shiya ibhokisi lephampu lingenalutho ukuze kube ngawo wonke).
wn.em.result: Kuvalwe kakhulu: {cut} {u}, izuhlangano: {n}. Ingcindezi ephansi kakhulu {minp} {p}. Okokuqala ngaphansi kobuncane: {first}.
wn.cal.help: Izilinganiso zasensimini, eyodwa ngomugqa: ingcindezi noma ukugeleza, ukuhlangana noma ipayipi, inani ({p} noma {q}), nokuba khona kwesisindo sesidingo ngalesosikhathi uma kudingeka. Amaqembu wamapayipi ashintsha ndawonye, eyodwa ngomugqa: igama: P1 P2 P3 (akukho = onke amapayipi ndawonye). Izilinganiso ezengeziwe kunamaqembu, nceda.
wn.cal.dm: Futhi lungisa isici esisodwa kuso sonke isidingo
wn.cal.result: Ukungafani ngaphambi {a}, ngemva {b} (1 kusho ukuthi kuseduze njengoba izilinganiso ngokwazo zinembile).
wn.sz.help: Nikeza usayizi ongawuthenga ({d}, kusuka kowancane kuya kowakhulu, uhlukaniswe ngamakhoma) nentengo ngeyunithi yobude ngayinye (usayizi = intengo, eyodwa ngomugqa). Ukugijima kukhulisa amapayipi asiza kakhulu ngemali kuze kube yilapho wonke ukuhlangana kufinyelela ingcindezi futhi kungekho payipi elisheshe kakhulu, bese kususwa noma yimuphi usayizi ongadingekile. Amapayipi awasoze anciphe.
wn.sz.no: Usayizi onikeziwe awukwazi ukufinyelela imikhawulo ({n} amapayipi azanywa, {cost} sonke). Engeza usayizi omkhulu.
wn.rh.help: Ukulungisa: amapayipi amadala aba nobukhulu C obuphansi. Qamba izinketho (igama, C entsha, intengo ngeyunithi yobude, eyodwa ngomugqa) nesabelomali; ukugijima kukhetha amapayipi aphakamisa ingcindezi kakhulu ngemali ngayinye. Ingcindezi ephansi kakhulu nejubane eliphezulu okungenhla kuyasebenza.
wn.rh.no: Isabelomali noma izinketho azifinyeleli imikhawulo: amapayipi angu-{n} akhethiwe, {cost} achithiwe.
